verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform that holds customer data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents user-configurable retention periods or deletion of data held in Sprinto. GDPR gap analysis, document-pack generation and PII detection are adjacent compliance features, not retention or deletion controls for the user's own data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
